held_refusal.evidence: the pre-commit hook chain refused the landing: this is the PRIMARY checkout and its HEAD 1d3b86ea5 is 1 commit(s) behind origin/main (549065782). A commit here would advance the shared branch on a base origin has moved past, so it cannot reach origin as itself: it strands until someone merges it, and a second landing of the same work from a worktree arrives on origin under another sha (the land-twice class). Nothing was gated or committed. Land from a worktree on the trunk instead: `git worktree add --detach <dir> origin/main`, copy the paths there, run `python3 -m tools.surgical_land` in it, then `python3 -m tools.promote_worktree_landing <dir>`. The shared checkout catches up when the reconciler fast-forwards it.
